## Skill name

`kebab-case-name` — must match `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$`

## Domain

Which domain directory does this belong in?
`[ ] react  [ ] rust  [ ] ui-ux  [ ] devops  [ ] testing  [ ] documentation  [ ] learn  [ ] other: ___`

## Description

One-line description (used in frontmatter, 1–1024 chars).

## When to trigger

Describe the user prompt or scenario that should invoke this skill.

## What it does

List the concrete steps or outputs the skill produces.

## Prerequisites

Any tools, binaries, or environment variables the skill depends on.

## Relationship to existing skills

Does this skill compose with or replace an existing one?

## Draft SKILL.md snippet (optional)

Paste a rough frontmatter block or outline if you have one.
